events.title: Brisbane Pinball Club
events.description: Every fortnight, the Brisbane Pinball Club meets in the Netherworld. Each meeting will require you to play 10 different pinball machines of the club’s choosing at your own pace. If you’ve ever wanted to join a Pinball club, this is your time to shine! It’s open to absolutely everybody and all skill levels. Prizes awarded to the top 8 places and playing will get you an International Flipper Pinball Association (IFPA) ranking. Head down anytime from 3pm to 7pm to get involved, with finals happening from 8.30pm! Entry is $20 with early bird entry of $15 if you make it down by 4pm.

events.title: Netherworld Trivia
events.description: **Please note there is no Trivia on the 2nd of September due to the Omiya showcase happening throughout the week. Netherworld’s weekly Trivia! Focusing on general pop culture, you’ve got to be current and not-so-current on your movie, television, games and weird event knowledge. Prizes for the top 3 teams and enamel pins for the winning team! It happens every Wednesday in the Netherworld at 6.30pm sharp. Registration is necessary and tables are seated on a first in best dressed basis. Registration opens the Thursday beforehand and you can sign up via trivia.netherworldarcade.com.

events.title: Blood on the Clocktower
events.description: BLOOD ON THE CLOCKTOWER SESSION: Wednesday September 9th at 7.30pm ****Tickets will go on sale from midday on Thursday the 6th of August via this page Join us for a new event in the Netherworld – Blood on the Clocktower! There’s been some busy traffic in this clocktower, so we’re now running this event fortnightly, alternating between Tuesday and Sunday evenings. Led by a grimoire wielding host, each participant will be given a role to play in an interactive social deduction game where death is not the end. Be ready for a night of lies, mystery and death for up to 16 players. Blood in the Clocktower is an Australian made game in the vein of Werewolf and Mafia by The Pandemonium Institute. You can check them out via http://bloodontheclocktower.com // @bloodontheclocktower The session happens in the Lost Souls area of Netherworld. Each ticket comes with your first drink and can be grabbed via www.netherworldarcade.com .

events.title: Netherworld Melee – Super Smash Bros Melee Meetup
events.description: Get Ready! Join us monthly on a Thursday from 6pm for NETHERWORLD MELEE, a casual Super Smash Bros Melee meetup. The Gamecube platform fighter classic still has a rabid following over 20 years after its release and for good reason. Whether you’re new to the game or have hundreds of hours clocked, we invite you to come take part in front of the warm glow of salvaged CRT. $10 registration on arrival, with door and tournament prizes in the mix. It happens in Lost Souls area of Netherworld with a tournament kicking off for 6pm and casual play welcome. Under 18 participants are welcome, though MUST be accompanied by their legal guardian.

events.title: Skill Shots – Level Up Your Pinball Game
events.description: Ready to level up your pinball game? Join us once a month on a Saturday morning to hang and chat all things pinball! Whether you’re a budding beginner, a functional flipper or a multiball maestro, you’re welcome to come and sharpen up your skills and help others do the same. From starting a game to learning advance flipper techniques and deep rule-sets, there’ll be friendly pinheads abound to assist you in imbibing from the pinball pool of knowledge. It’s free to take part and you’ll be gifted a pinball skills booklet to guide you on your pinball journey to masterdom. It kicks off from 10am with the venue open to the non-pinball pre-occupied public from the regular midday start.

events.title: The Snouts + Revelation Groove – Live in the Arcade
events.description: Join us this Sunday afternoon for an absolute ear hole party with two bands hailing from Meanjin/Brisbane – The Snouts & Revelation Groove Live in the Arcade First up is eight-piece Revelation Groove. These beautiful humans will treat us with their blend of Latin-jazz-funk-soul-blues with keyboards, accordion, bass, guitar, saxophone, percussion, violin, drums and sweet, sweet vocal harmonies. @revelationgroove revelationgroove.bandcamp.com Then the Snouts return to their Brisbane trough in the Netherworld! This semi-wholesome 5 piece gorges on raucous energetic punk and classic ska. Their infectious live energy will cure what ails you on a Sunday afternoon. @thesnoutsband http://thesnouts1.bandcamp.com Grab a drink and meet us in the arcade from 3pm to get your skank on! Free to join in with the Netherworld open from midday for pre-gig beers, burgers and games.

events.title: Belles & Chimes Women’s Pinball Meetup
events.description: Join us on a Tuesday evening from 6pm for Belles and Chimes women’s pinball meetup in the Netherworld! Belles and Chimes (www.bellesandchimespinball.com) is a group of meetups established in 2013 that happens around the world to provide a casual, inclusive space to learn and play pinball with like minded folks. There’s no strict format – all you need to do is meet up, grab a drink and play! It will happen monthly on Tuesdays throughout the year. It’s free to join in and is open to women and non-binary persons of all skills levels.

events.title: Loop De Loop Mini Animation Festival – Cheat
events.description: Our next screening in September is CHEAT. Our most cunning and conniving theme, come watch some animated loops of life’s most sneaky cheats and hacks. This edition happens on Tuesday the 15th of September at 7pm and is free to join in. Loop de loop is a monthly mini-animation festival showing looping animations from all across Australia and the world! Join us to watch, applaud and judge fresh animation each month at the Netherworld arcade room.

events.title: Netherworld Trivia
events.description: Netherworld’s weekly Trivia! Focusing on general pop culture, you’ve got to be current and not-so-current on your movie, television, games and weird event knowledge. Prizes for the top 3 teams and enamel pins for the winning team! It happens every Wednesday in the Netherworld at 6.30pm sharp. Registration is necessary and tables are seated on a first in best dressed basis. Registration opens the Thursday beforehand and you can sign up via trivia.netherworldarcade.com.

events.title: Fighting Spirits – Casual Fighting Game Night
events.description: Join us for FIGHTING SPIRITS, a monthly Fighting Game event happening in the Lost Souls area of Netherworld. REGO: https://www.start.gg/tournament/fightingspirits Get involved in casual play of a variety of games, With Street Fighter 6 and various anime fighting titles BYO games and controllers absolutely welcome, with most games played on PS5. Bring your own controller, arcade stick, leverless, or monstrosity you use to play fighting games. Most games will be played on PS5, so you’ll want to ensure your controller is compatible. The event is $10 on arrival and kicks off from 6pm. ** Under 18’s are welcome, but they must be accompanied by their parent at all times.
